recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered collage featuring three men lying on a beach, each with a heart-shaped thought bubble above them containing a black-and-white portrait of a woman. The composition is set against a solid sky-blue background with dense, multi-styled retro typography at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical hierarchy from bold header text to beach scene at the bottom.
Symmetrical arrangement of three heart-shaped vignettes.
Contrast between full-color beach photography and monochrome portraits.
Visual link between men and women via circular 'thought' bubbles.
coreInvariants: Solid sky-blue border and header area.
Three distinct subjects in both the foreground and the thought bubbles.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three men occupy the bottom third; three large hearts occupy the middle third; text occupies the top third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central heart-shaped portrait acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow from the large header, through the hearts, to the beach scene.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid blue margins frame the central photographic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sky blue background providing a clean, retro frame.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black and white for the interior heart portraits to distinguish memory/thought from reality.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow and red for secondary graphic elements and text highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the blue and yellow elements against muted, naturalistic beach tones.

letterConstructionRules: Header uses a wide, geometric sans-serif with tight tracking.
Secondary logos use heavy, rounded scripts with thick outlines.
Sub-text uses slanted, italicized sans-serifs with underline accents.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Script letters feature heavy drop shadows and interlocking strokes.
Italicized text includes horizontal speed lines or underlines.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of rigid geometric headers with fluid, expressive scripts.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric structure and width of the main header.
Captures the casual, retro energy of the secondary logo.
Provides the necessary weight and slant for the technical sub-text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a beach scene with three men lying on the sand looking forward, with three heart-shaped monochrome portraits of women floating above them as thought bubbles, all set against a solid sky-blue border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a wide geometric sans-serif header at the top, a heavy yellow script logo with red outlines on the left, and italicized black text with underlines on the right.

verificationChecks: Is the background a consistent sky blue?
Do the portraits inside the hearts remain black and white?
Is the typography layered correctly without obscuring the faces?

adjustableVariables: Number of subjects in the beach scene
Shape of the thought bubbles (e.g., stars instead of hearts)
mustRedesign: Specific character faces to avoid likeness issues
Unique script logo to avoid trademarked branding
Specific text content to generic placeholder text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the beach scene is in color and hearts are in B&W.
Verify the header text is centered and wide.
Confirm the presence of the yellow/red script logo.
Check for the circular 'bubbles' connecting men to hearts.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Beach Photography] with [Monochrome Heart Portraits] inside a [Sky Blue Frame] topped with [Geometric Sans-Serif and Outlined Script Typography].
